For Lenders & Credit Funds

You hold the loan. We give you an operator's read on the asset behind it.

Independent operational assessment, turnaround feasibility, and interim leadership for lenders and credit funds exposed to maritime, transport, and logistics assets.

The problem

What you are really up against

When a maritime credit starts to wobble, the financials tell you something is wrong, not whether the business can be fixed. You need an operator's judgment: can this be turned around, who should run it, and what is the asset really worth in operating terms, not just on paper. Especially in distressed situations, that read decides whether you support, restructure, or push.

What you get

Deliverables, not a deck of theory

  • An independent operational assessment of the borrower's business.
  • A turnaround feasibility view: what's fixable, what isn't, and what it takes.
  • Ongoing monitoring reports if you want eyes on the asset over time.
How we work

Our process

Fast, independent, and discreet. A focused assessment first, then optional interim or monitoring support, with weekly updates. We focus on maritime, transport, and logistics assets across the US and Europe.

Track record

What our founding team has done

Our founder has led operational turnarounds and margin expansion inside PE-owned maritime businesses.

Every item below reflects work our team has personally led, as operators, before Navex.

  • Grew EBITDA by more than 130% in 15 months as regional CEO of a global maritime services group, rebuilding a commercial pipeline from near zero to over $30M.
  • As chief commercial officer of a PE-owned marine services company, delivered several consecutive years of 50 to 77% revenue and EBITDA growth, executed six bolt-on acquisitions across three continents, and helped deliver a successful exit.
  • Worked through four private-equity ownership rounds at a global ship management group, including a $1.3bn transaction.
  • Across a 25-year operating career: five exits, more than ten bolt-on acquisitions, and over $1bn in enterprise value shaped.

Figures reflect the founding team's operator experience prior to Navex.
